text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in 5xxs for api.redwood.com starting ~07:02 UTC. Most errors are TLS handshake failures and connection timeouts from multiple EU edge POPs. Paging on-call.
alice: I’m on it. ACKing. Which regions are impacted? any customer reports?
monitoring-bot: metrics link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/api-5xx?orgId=1&from=now-15m to=now - 1m aggregated 5xx rate jumped x8, median latency unchanged for healthy requests.
maya: quick summary from edge logs — Cloudflare edge TLS handshake timeouts (handshake duration > 15s) and some 525/524. Sample from edge-log:
```
[2026-03-15T07:03:12Z] edge=fra1 cf_peer=104.37.174.52 tls_err=handshake_timeout path=/v1/generate status=524
```
ben: running dig from two public resolvers, results differ:
```
$ dig +short api.redwood.com @1.1.1.1
104.37.174.52
$ dig +short api.redwood.com @8.8.8.8
104.37.174.53
```
maya: traceroute to both IPs from eu-west shows different CF pops, some hops `* * *` indicating packet loss at last hop.
carlos: Support page shows Cloudflare incidents for TLS/edge in EU: https://cloudflarestatus.com/incidents/abcd-1234 (partial outage). I'm opening a ticket.
cloudflare-support-bot: Ticket CF-789012 created with priority HIGH, assigned to edge-team. Contact: oncall-edge@cloudflare.com
jesse: Support queue: multiple customers reporting 502/524 and timeouts; sample ticket: "API requests failing with TLS errors since 07:02, token exchange fails" — sending a heads-up email to affected customers now.
rina: Noting customer-impacted list: accounts A123, B456, C789 showing elevated error rates and some synchronous request timeouts. No data loss reported.
alice: Mitigation plan proposal: 1) shift routing for eu traffic to us-east reachable POPs via temporary Traffic Manager rule, 2) add DNS fallback to secondary A records that point to our backup origin (fastly-backed origin) for reads-only endpoints, 3) open Cloudflare ticket (done), 4) throttle retry at gateway to reduce cascade.
ben: I can flip the Traffic Manager rule. Doing a dry-run command:
```
# apply temporary route for /v1/health and /v1/embeddings to us-east
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: traffic-manager-overrides
data:
  route: |
    - match: /v1/embeddings
      target: us-east-origin
    - match: /v1/health
      target: us-east-origin
EOF
```
ben: applied. Monitoring routing propagation; DNS TTL low (30s) so clients should pick up changes quickly.
maya: while we shift traffic, we should disable TLS 1.3 0-RTT on the origin to avoid handshake edge cases. Pushing config change to origin load balancer now.
alice: rolling change to origin TLS config. patch:
```
origin-tls.conf: set min_version = TLS1.2
disable_0rtt = true
```
carlos: I updated the runbook and notified sales/CS. Also opening a status page update draft.
monitoring-bot: After routing change, 5xx rate dropped ~65% in ~90s for eu-heavy traces. Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/recovery
jesse: Notifying affected customers that we have a partial mitigation in place and are monitoring. Message drafted.
rina: Escalation note: if CF doesn't resolve in 30m, we'll failover DNS to secondary provider for all api traffic. ETA to prep full failover ~12m.
alice: handing off to ben for on-call for next 4 hours. Handoff notes: mitigation applied (Traffic Manager override + origin TLS change), CF ticket CF-789012, watch for reversion on Cloudflare side. console link: https://console.redwood.internal/incidents/2471234567
ben: taking over. Will keep monitoring, will post updates every 15m or on signal. :thumbsup:
cloudflare-support-bot: Edge-team acknowledges investigation. They report an internal routing flap affecting TLS handshakes in EU and are rolling a fix. Estimated fix: 20-40 minutes.
ben: putting postmortem skeleton in docs and assigning actions: (1) add automatic CDN failover runbook, (2) improve cross-pop TLS metric alerts, (3) test DNS failover weekly.
alice: thanks everyone. If anyone sees new customer P1s, ping me directly. :pray:
